stories.title: Connah’s Quay teen to fly to USA to compete for Great Britain in inline hockey
stories.summary: A 13-year-old from Connah’s Quay has been selected to represent Great Britain in inline hockey and will travel to the United States in July to compete in two tournaments. stories.title: Public Health Wales issues extreme heat advice for Wales as amber warning covers Deeside through Thursday
stories.summary: Public Health Wales has issued an urgent call for people to look out for one another as north Wales faces a period of extreme heat, with an amber warning in place for Deeside from Wednesday midnight through to Thursday night. stories.title: Seven-month road closures and National Grid works among Flintshire’s roadworks this week
stories.summary: Drivers across Flintshire are facing road closures and temporary traffic lights at dozens of locations this week, with three roads in Penyffordd closed for water works that are scheduled to run until January 2027. stories.title: Home sales in north Wales could be four weeks faster under UK Government reform plans
stories.summary: Buyers and sellers in north Wales could see home sales completed up to four weeks faster under Government plans announced on Friday to overhaul the way properties are bought and sold in England and Wales. stories.title: Coleg Cambria’s brightest stars recognised at student awards
stories.summary: From future engineers and entrepreneurs to award-winning creatives and apprentices already making their mark in industry, some of Coleg Cambria’s most outstanding learners were honoured at its annual Student Awards.
